text: 香港证监会发布最新一份证券业财务回顾报告指出，香港证券业在今年上半年录得稳健增长，淨盈利较2025年下半年增加21%，至517亿港元。 证券经纪行的交易活动增长强劲，客户参与度日益上升，使盈利较2025年下半年大幅增加。今年上半年，证券经纪行的交易总额较2025年下半年跃升24%，创下149万亿港元的纪录；截至6月的活跃客户人数亦增加10%至约570万。 在经纪行的主要收入来源中，交易佣金及利息收入较2025年下半年增加13%，至454亿港元，部分抵消资产管理相关费用收入下降21%至244亿港元的影响，因此行业总收入大致保持平稳。支出方面，开支及利息支出
text_en: The Securities and Futures Commission (SFC) of Hong Kong released its latest Securities Industry Financial Review report, noting that Hong Kong's securities industry recorded steady growth in the first half of this year, with net profit increasing 21% from the second half of 2025 to HK$51.7 billion. Securities brokers saw strong growth in trading activity and rising client participation, driving a substantial increase in profit compared with the second half of 2025. In the first half of this year, total trading turnover of securities brokers jumped 24% from the second half of 2025 to a record HK$149 trillion; the number of active clients as of June also rose 10% to about 5.7 million. Among brokers' main revenue sources, trading commissions and interest income increased 13% from the second half of 2025 to HK$45.4 billion, partly offsetting a 21% decline in asset management-related fee income to HK$24.4 billion, so total industry revenue remained roughly flat.
